propositions: Four capability call sites in dispatch_one.py and dispatch_apply_phases.py use static casts (add_comment, set_relationship) without runtime isinstance guards, creating silent failures when a transport lacks the capability.
AttributeError at these sites is caught by broad exception handlers, causing mutations to be silently skipped without surfacing the capability absence to observers.

Runtime isinstance guards against @runtime_checkable Protocols (SupportsComments, SupportsLinks) must be added before capability member calls, with a fallback to hasattr for proxy/wrapper transports that use __getattr__.

Capability-absent conditions must be logged and recorded to bridge_alerts with distinct kind strings (outbound-comment-capability-absent, outbound-links-capability-absent) to distinguish designed skips from real failures.
Module size constraint requires relocating _call_with_retry from dispatch_one.py (~75 LOC) to dispatch_apply_phases.py to fit both modules within the 800-LOC cap.
